Hi Jordan,

A colleague at Modern Treasury said they're celebrating their eighth birthday while reflecting on how payments infrastructure is evolving and what it means when money moves from A to B. It got me thinking about the manual, reconciliation‑heavy processes many operations teams still wrestle with. I'd love to explore how we could help Modern Treasury automate those workflows and free up your team for higher‑value work.

Best,
Zamp
